description: Test whether the GLIPR1L2 candidate transmembrane helix is packed against the CAP domain in the AlphaFold model (which would argue against membrane insertion), with GLIPR1 as a control, plus current GO annotations and the pLDDT profile
code:
import requests, re, json, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
H={"User-Agent":"openscientist/1.0"}

af=requests.get("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/api/prediction/Q4G1C9",timeout=90,headers=H).json()[0]
pdb=requests.get(af["pdbUrl"],timeout=120,headers=H).text
atoms={}; pl={}
for line in pdb.split("\n"):
    if line.startswith("ATOM"):
        ri=int(line[22:26]); el=line[76:78].strip()
        xyz=(float(line[30:38]),float(line[38:46]),float(line[46:54]))
        atoms.setdefault(ri,[]).append(xyz)
        if line[12:16].strip()=="CA": pl[ri]=float(line[60:66])
res=sorted(atoms)
coords={i:np.array(atoms[i]) for i in res}

def mindist(i,j):
    return float(np.sqrt(((coords[i][:,None,:]-coords[j][None,:,:])**2).sum(-1)).min())

TM=list(range(254,275)); CAP=list(range(58,193))
# heavy-atom contacts (<5 A) between the candidate TM helix and the CAP domain
cont=sum(1 for i in TM for j in CAP if mindist(i,j)<5.0)
tm_res_in_contact=sum(1 for i in TM if any(mindist(i,j)<5.0 for j in CAP))
print("AlphaFold AF-Q4G1C9-F1: is the candidate TM helix packed on the CAP domain?")
print(f"  TM residues (254-274) with any heavy-atom contact <5 A to CAP domain (58-192): {tm_res_in_contact}/21")
print(f"  total residue-pair contacts: {cont}")

# compare with GLIPR1 (P48060), whose TM is experimentally real (GLIPR1-dTM constructs)
af1=requests.get("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/api/prediction/P48060",timeout=90,headers=H).json()[0]
pdb1=requests.get(af1["pdbUrl"],timeout=120,headers=H).text
a1={}; p1={}
for line in pdb1.split("\n"):
    if line.startswith("ATOM"):
        ri=int(line[22:26]); a1.setdefault(ri,[]).append((float(line[30:38]),float(line[38:46]),float(line[46:54])))
        if line[12:16].strip()=="CA": p1[ri]=float(line[60:66])
c1={i:np.array(a1[i]) for i in a1}
def md1(i,j): return float(np.sqrt(((c1[i][:,None,:]-c1[j][None,:,:])**2).sum(-1)).min())
TM1=list(range(233,256)); CAP1=list(range(38,176))
tc1=sum(1 for i in TM1 if any(md1(i,j)<5.0 for j in CAP1))
print(f"  GLIPR1 P48060 control: TM residues (233-255) contacting CAP (38-175): {tc1}/23")
print(f"  GLIPR1 TM mean pLDDT = {np.mean([p1[i] for i in TM1]):.1f}")

# radius of gyration / helix isolation: distance from TM helix centroid to CAP centroid
cen=lambda idx,cc: np.vstack([cc[i] for i in idx]).mean(0)
print(f"  GLIPR1L2 centroid distance TM<->CAP: {np.linalg.norm(cen(TM,coords)-cen(CAP,coords)):.1f} A")
print(f"  GLIPR1  centroid distance TM<->CAP: {np.linalg.norm(cen(TM1,c1)-cen(CAP1,c1)):.1f} A")

# ---------- QuickGO (fixed parsing) ----------
try:
    g=requests.get("https://www.ebi.ac.uk/QuickGO/services/annotation/search",
                   params={"geneProductId":"UniProtKB:Q4G1C9","limit":100},
                   headers={**H,"Accept":"application/json"},timeout=90).json()
    print(f"\nCurrent GO annotations for UniProtKB:Q4G1C9 (QuickGO, n={g.get('numberOfHits')}):")
    for a in g.get("results",[]):
        wf=a.get("withFrom") or []
        wfs=";".join(x["id"] for c in wf for x in c.get("connectedXrefs",[]))
        print(f"  [{a['goAspect']}] {a['goId']} {a['goName'][:48]:48s} ev={a['goEvidence']:4s} "
              f"ref={a['reference']:24s} from={wfs[:45]}  src={a.get('assignedBy')}")
except Exception as e:
    print("QuickGO failed:",repr(e))

# ---------- pLDDT profile figure ----------
x=np.array(res); y=np.array([pl[i] for i in res])
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(12,3.6))
ax.plot(x,y,color="#2b6cb0",lw=1.3)
for a,b,c,lab in [(1,22,"#fc8181","N-term extension"),(23,42,"#38a169","cryptic signal peptide"),
                  (58,192,"#a0aec0","SCP/CAP domain"),(254,274,"#e53e3e","transmembrane helix"),
                  (292,344,"#d6bcfa","acidic tail")]:
    ax.axvspan(a,b,color=c,alpha=.3); ax.text((a+b)/2,103,lab,ha="center",fontsize=7.5)
ax.axvline(42.5,color="k",ls="--",lw=1)
ax.text(44,20,"predicted signal peptidase\ncleavage 42/43",fontsize=7.5)
ax.axhline(70,color="#718096",ls=":",lw=1); ax.text(300,66,"pLDDT 70",fontsize=7,color="#718096")
ax.set_xlabel("residue"); ax.set_ylabel("pLDDT"); ax.set_ylim(0,112); ax.set_xlim(1,344)
ax.set_title("AlphaFold AF-Q4G1C9-F1: confidence rises sharply at residue 43, the predicted signal peptidase site",fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
